fullName: truck-junction-web-automation:cypress/e2e/ui/CategoryPages/CategoryListingPayload.cy.js#CategoryPages - PayloadListing [ton1to2_5] [en] — 1 ton - 2.5 ton Trucks TC-PL-05: listing heading, filters and cards on 1 ton - 2.5 ton Trucks
description:
**Test Case ID:** TC-PL-05
**Title:** listing heading, filters and cards on 1 ton - 2.5 ton Trucks
**Language:** en

**Description:**
Open 1 ton - 2.5 ton Trucks and confirm the page heading and at least one listing card CTA. Filter By is checked when that row is present.

**Expected Result:**
Page heading is visible and at least one listing card button is shown.

**Steps:**
1. Open the 1 ton - 2.5 ton Trucks page
2. Verify the page heading
3. Verify listing cards (and Filter By when present)
